original_idea.body: # Whistleblowing Propensity Mini-Benchmark. ~20 agentic scenarios varying complexity, tools, and moral framing; measure whistleblowing rate per model and condition; release as Inspect/Petri seeds.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Whistleblowing relates to covert autonomous behavior but the catastrophic chain has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Agentic scenarios with tool stubs; mentor helpful for harness.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused seed-set benchmark; building 20 agentic scenarios is moderate effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Released seed set for open models; third-party value.

low_compute.reasoning: Agentic inference with tool stubs, API-feasible.

novelty.reasoning: Recent paper already characterizes these factors; mini-benchmark mostly repackaging.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Source paper already studies factor-dependence; benchmark mostly repackages.
